scope.claim_boundary: synthetic algorithmic and representation evidence only; no biomedical or live-API generalization claim

development_decision_rules.dagger: Use the dev-selected DAgger checkpoint only if its best dev selection score strictly exceeds the initial cosine seed-17 score; otherwise retain the initial cosine checkpoint.
development_decision_rules.capacity: Retain configured capacity unless the clean resume-v3 two-x model has a positive paired task-bootstrap joint-accuracy interval excluding zero over configured capacity. Capacity does not alter the already selected cosine distance.
development_decision_rules.representation: The frozen-representation contribution is accepted only if the clean resume-v3 frozen-cosine minus parameter-matched-hash joint-accuracy interval excludes zero in the favorable direction; otherwise report it as unresolved.
development_decision_rules.input_ablation: Ablations are attribution analyses and cannot replace the preregistered full-input primary model after seeing test.
development_decision_rules.state_flow: Train seeds 17, 29, and 43 independently; do not select a seed on test. Report each seed and the seed mean.

single_unseal_evaluation.materialization: After every development controller and robustness check is terminal, build a separate final processed/cache package containing the registered test split and append a test-access ledger event.
single_unseal_evaluation.value_policy_supporting: All three already trained full-input cosine seed checkpoints, reported without selecting the best test seed
state_flow_controls: external verifier STOP guard reported only as an explicit ablation
single_unseal_evaluation.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over independent test tasks; correlated prefixes are not treated as independent observations.
single_unseal_evaluation.multiplicity: Primary contrasts are observed replan minus one-shot and observed replan minus blind. Geometry and input comparisons remain development analyses.

future_real_data_split.preferred_external_test_tasks_for_precis: 200-400 when an additional independent source is available
future_real_data_split.marrvel_policy: All MARRVEL-derived tasks are external test-only. Because public items were inspected for executable curation, call it a curation-fixed held-out external benchmark, not a pristine blind test.
